# pymmcore-plus

> Control microscopes with Python: Micro-Manager's core, acquisition engine, widgets, and apps.

Python tools for controlling microscopes with Micro-Manager: pymmcore-plus (core + acquisition engine), useq-schema (experiment schema), pymmcore-widgets (Qt widgets), pymmcore-gui and napari-micromanager (applications).

## Getting started

- [Your first acquisition](<https://pymmcore-plus.github.io/getting-started/first-acquisition/index.md>)
- [Your first GUI](<https://pymmcore-plus.github.io/getting-started/first-gui/index.md>)
- [First steps](<https://pymmcore-plus.github.io/getting-started/first-steps/index.md>)
- [Which package do I need?](<https://pymmcore-plus.github.io/getting-started/index.md>)
- [Installation](<https://pymmcore-plus.github.io/getting-started/install/index.md>)
